lines.en: I hop along, a block at a time.
The grass in this wood is taller than me.

lines.zh: 我停下来，耳朵先动，草叶太响。
lines.en: I stop; my ears move first, the grass is loud.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一跳就过草丛。
lines.en: Small as I am, one hop clears the grass.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我熟得能闭眼走。
lines.en: I know this wood well enough to walk blind.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一蹬，就出去好远。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs carries far.
I hop over a tree root.
Two hops, then I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 有声音，我改成慢慢地挪。
lines.en: A sound. I slow to a creep.
Along the forest edge, hop and stop.

lines.zh: 风吹草动，我都要看一眼。
lines.en: Any stir in the grass gets a look.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很小，很快就没了。
lines.en: My prints are small. They fade fast.

lines.zh: 这一带没有危险，我放松些。
lines.en: Nothing dangerous here. I relax a little.
I hop a narrow stream.

lines.zh: 草地上的露水，把脚弄湿了。
lines.en: Dew on the grass wets my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，几乎没有声。
lines.en: I go lightly. Almost silent.
I crouch and wash my face with my forepaws.
A sound far off turns my ears.
I'm eating grass. Bite by bite.
Good sun. I narrow my eyes.
My ears turn toward the woods.
I press my nose to the grass.

lines.zh: 这一片很安全，我放心了。
lines.en: This spot is safe. I'm easy.
I yawn and my teeth show.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪屁股，换个方向。
lines.en: I shift my rump to face another way.
A beetle crawls on a blade of grass.
I sit up and look around.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵放平，休息一下。
lines.en: I lay my ears back and rest.
The wind ruffles my fur.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，就这样待着。
lines.en: I do nothing. Just stay.
The grass here is sweeter.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能转半圈，听着四面。
lines.en: My ears turn half a circle, listening everywhere.
Have you crouched down?

lines.zh: 我三点生命，耳朵倒很长。
lines.en: Three points of life, and very long ears.

lines.zh: 兔耳朵一转，听你的脚步。
lines.en: My rabbit ears turn to your footsteps.
I step back, then stop.
Bring that hand close and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴在草上，闻露水。
lines.en: I press my nose to the grass and smell dew.

lines.zh: 你这么高，我怎么跑得过。
lines.en: You're so tall. How would I outrun you?

lines.zh: 一只耳朵朝你，一只朝后。
lines.en: One ear on you, one on what's behind.
Are you giving me something to eat?
Three health, and the ears move first.
Like this, neither of us moves.
I turn and hop two steps away.

lines.zh: 我只有三点生命，跑得却快。
lines.en: Three health, but I run fast.
I only have three hit points.
Three hit points left, curled into a fur ball.
My leg's sore, but I can hop.
I retreat into the grass.
Three health. Easy.
Ears flat on my back means fear.
I'm shaking too hard to stand.
That hit my hind leg.
I am only nibbling this grass.
Carrots! I smell orange.
I won't snatch. Wait.
The smell of carrot softens my ears.
Two hops closer, then I stop.
Set it down. I'll come myself.
I hold it in both forepaws and eat.
Crisp. I like it.
Three bites, then a look around.
Give me another.
Done. I lick my nose.
Small as I am, everyone wants to eat me.
I like that colour.

lines.zh: 我把头伸过去，耳朵先动。
lines.en: I stretch my head over. My ears move first.
My front teeth won't slow down.
I'll save this mouthful.
You touched a carrot, didn't you?
I bump it and bounce off.
Your boot tip sends me tumbling.
I land off course and hit your boot.
I land on all four at once.
I slip around your legs.
One turn of my ears and I bolt.
Dirt falls from between my ears.
Your feet are too big to dodge.
I hop onto a stone for height.
That turned me right around.

lines.zh: 我用后腿跺地，砰砰两下。
lines.en: I drum the ground twice with my hind feet.
Two pairs of hind legs thump together.
Circling hops flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵竖起来给它看。
lines.en: I raise my ears for it to see.
One ahead, one behind.
My ears are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 草被我们踩平了一小块。
lines.en: We flatten a small patch of grass.
Still light out. Take our time.
It ducks into the grass, and I follow.
Enough wood here for us.
This leaf will line the burrow.
A seed husk is stuck on my front teeth.
Holding the berry, I tilt my head at it.
Edible? Let me bite.
A stone. I thought it was food.
I hop with it, and the berry rolls away.
I find a spot to stash it.
Sweet berry. One more bite.
Small enough to gnaw.
I sit and gnaw slowly.
I flatten my ears and curl up.
I watch you from the corner of my eye.
Both ears snap up and lock on.

lines.zh: 三滴血的兔子，跑得很快。
lines.en: A three-health bunny runs fast.
Against that, I'm outmatched.
The grass is tall. I can hide.
Two thumps of my hind feet.
Showing my front teeth is a warning.
Step back and we'll call it nothing.
Three points, and all I want is to run.
Rabbit eyes don't blink. It's fear.
You step, I step back.
I edge toward the taller grass.
My ears stay on you.
A little longer, to see where it goes.

lines.zh: 你的影子伸过来，我退了。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches me. I shrink back.
Nose to the ground, I sniff out the path.
My heart races. I hold still.
One move from you and I'm in the grass.
My ears stay pointed at you.
My forepaws flail without much force.
One bite, then straight back.
A kick from my hind legs stings.
You grabbed me first. That's why I bit.
My whole body hits your ankle.
I kick off you and leap away.
Small teeth. Shallow bite.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一竖，就听见你了。
lines.en: One perk of my ears and I hear you.
That drained the last of my strength.
Only when you're gone do I stop.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里探出头，耳朵先动。
lines.en: I poke out of the grass, ears moving first.
This wood is very quiet.
I shake my ears and get my bearings.
The grass just covers my head.
I hop twice to test my legs.
Nice breeze. I squint.
I poke my head out of the burrow to look.
One bite first, then think.
The light in the wood comes in pieces.
I'm small. Easy to miss.

lines.zh: 毛烧起来了，我到处乱跳。
lines.en: My fur catches fire. I bounce about wildly.
At the bottom, my ears still spin.
Water fills my ears and I sink.
I land in the grass and lie still a long while.
The arrow grazes my back and takes a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠上来，毛全竖了。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and all my fur stands up.
The winter is long; I've chewed the roots.
My fur is singed and smells like burnt grass.
There's not even a grass root in the void.
